Make backups through the real form and pickers: Incremental and Plain, phone to drive and drive to phone. Back up now stores nothing new, one changed file stores one. Verify reads every blob, Restore compares by hash outside the app, Mount reads the repository the app wrote. Keep rules, a target inside its source, an empty source, Cancel, too big, nearly full with both answers, Remove. Host: filesystem checker clean, restic check --read-data on every repository, copies by hash.
